entries.message: The model is one loop — an environment (the artifact and its constraints) and an agent (a bounded language model) joined by two channels, observation and action, through the interface — with an objective and dynamics below and a meta layer around everything saying how any reading is trusted.

The loop minimises one loss, a count of defects; that count's reader term is priced at three finer grains — per claim, per token, per rendering — and, for proof libraries, by a corpus functional; each finer functional prices the one above it.

MetaProof's exploration frontier, 71 nodes, coloured by status: 38 measured, 11 in-progress, 16 hypothesis, 5 planned, 1 killed. Zero sealed against 38 measured is the gap bin/frontier_refactor.py already found by counting; this is the same fact, seen instead of computed.

One loop: the environment on the left and the agent on the right exchange observations and actions through an interface; below, the objective, the dynamics, and how problems become tasks; every variable of the model has exactly one home, with its measurement status on it.
figbank's own tracked files, as a tree: the bank visualizing its own toolkit, laid out by treelayout.js from nothing but each file's directory.
owner suggested reviewing tt-a1i/archify; this spec demonstrates the one pattern taken from it (boundaries) on the bank's own pipeline, not a consumer's model
